title: Enable a systemd service to start on boot
summary: Configure a service to start automatically every time you turn on your computer. You can also start it immediately without rebooting.

steps.explain: Enable the service so it starts on boot, and start it immediately. Replace <SERVICE_NAME> with the name of the service.

placeholders.name: SERVICE_NAME
placeholders.description: The name of the systemd unit (e.g., sshd, cups).

steps.expect: No error output. The service should now be active and enabled.

rollback.explain: Disable the service so it no longer starts on boot and stop it immediately.

placeholders.name: SERVICE_NAME
placeholders.description: The name of the systemd unit.

warnings: Enabling unnecessary services can slow down boot time or introduce security risks.
